evidence.title: Prediction Market · React motion component · beUI
Animated Components for React and Next.js · beUI

name: Prediction Market
summary: Animated prediction-market listing cards and a buy/sell trade ticket for React, installed via shadcn or copied.
description: Two beUI block components for prediction markets. Market listing cards show outcome rows with animated odds CTAs that roll into Yes/No labels on hover or focus, payout multipliers, bookmarks and an optional volume sparkline; the trade ticket has buy/sell modes, quick-add amount chips, a rolling number entry and a live quote. Props cover outcomes, live status, balance, positions and trade callbacks; install with the shadcn CLI (@beui/prediction-market-card, @beui/prediction-market) or copy the source.
contains: market listing cards with outcome CTAs that roll into Yes/No labels on hover or focus
optional volume sparkline (volumeHistory) in the card footer
trade ticket with buy/sell modes, quick-add chips and rolling amount entry
props: outcomes, status, live, bookmarked, balance, positions, onTrade
shared motion files: number-ticker, tabs, tooltip, button, magnetic
